batting.dismissal: c MM Patel b Kamran Khan

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c M Rawat b MM Patel

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c Kamran Khan b MM Patel

batting.name: SA Asnodkar
batting.dismissal: c RR Powar b IK Pathan

batting.name: GC Smith
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b IK Pathan

batting.name: RJ Quiney
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b YA Abdulla

batting.dismissal: c K Goel b PP Chawla

batting.name: AS Raut
batting.dismissal: c RR Powar b PP Chawla

balls.text: full and straight again, hit to the left of Munaf and he hurts himself by getting a hand on it: the pace has been taken off, and the batsmen can come back for two
full and stright again, just short of being a yorker, and only a single to long-on
whoa, Munaf is diving, off hos own bowling, after having bowled a yorker, across in front of the non-striker, what an over, another dot ball
that's an ordinary call, it's like a schoolkid, Chawla has walked across outside off, and another slower ball, this cuts across that wide marker, and is given wide
superb comeback by Munaf after that first-ball boundary, slower ball, 107ks, and Chawla is beaten again
and he is beaten by a slower ball this time, already down to front foot and is fooled
and Chawla has made up a bit for that run-out of Sanga with a fantastic shot, it was just short of a yorker, on off, and Chawla makes room and crisply hits it square of thirdman for four

and he is run out, poor thinking by Chawla, Sanga is beaten by the short delivery, but wants to come through for a bye, but Chawla doesn't respond, and Sanga is caught yards short. Agreed there wasn't a single there, but Chawla should have sacrificed his wicket to keep Sanga on strike
big shout for lbw, Chawla was walking across, but must have been saved by the late inswing
fulltoss on the off stump, Sanga is making room already, plays it into the ground, and through to point
and Sanga steps down and flat-batts it straight down the ground, what a shot, it was hit on the up
unlucky to miss the stumps this time, full and fast, swinging in from outside off, 142ks, beats Chawla, but they steal a bye

If Warne can't, his prodigy will, off the inside edge, this is full and fast, and Irfan looks to go off side, but is late into it, and gets a thick inside edge onto the stumps. This will pull Punjab back after a superb partnership
Warne wasn't destined to get Irfan, beat him in the flight again as he stepped out, and this falls just short of midwicket
top sweep shot, it's pitched on the pads, and he gets nice and low, and finds the gap between deep backward square and deep fine leg
cramped up by the big turn, Irfan has no room to force it through off side
thrown up, on the stumps, and he slog-sweeps, but the midwicket is deep
that's 50 for Sanga, and what a shot to get it, it's short and fast on the pads, and he pulls it over fine leg, lovely shot
clever, 74ks, on the stumps, Sanga has to make all the pace but can't beat cover
this is just short of a length, outside off, Irfan looks to make room, but it holds its line, and beats the waft
fast, short of a length, angling in, no room, just a limp single to cover
beats Irfan again, this one pitches outside off, but doesn't bounce enough, and goes underneath the bat, and troubles Rawat too
lovely bowling, slower yorker, 117ks, outside off, beats Irfan's bat coming down
yorker, swinging in towards off, Sanga digs it out, and manages to get it down to long-on
full, swinging into the pads, beats irfan, but will get a leg-bye
short, looks to make room, but this turns big, still Sanga manages to force it through cover
brother drops brother, Yusuf at deep backward sqaure didn't pick this early, Irfan stepped out again, is beaten in the flight, and gets the inside half towards Yusuf, but it falls inches in front
that's too short, and he gets away with it, on the stumps, Sanga pulls but finds a deep fielder
thrown up this time, and played towards long-off
similar length, but the cut is not on because it turns in sharply and cramps him
just short of a length, doesn't turn this time, and Irfan waits and cuts this through the off side, top shot
angled onto the pads, and helped away towards midwicket
fast again, but fuller, and driven straight to Smith at point
even faster this time, but angling down leg
flat and fast, and Irfan uses the pace, waits on it, opens the face and beats point and gets it sqaure of sweeper-cover
Sanga looks for the loft too, but is beaten in the flight, gets the inside half but safe single to midwicket
flat this time, on off stump, and a single to mid-off
Irfan launches his brother into the midwicket stand, saw it angling into him, stepped out, mad eroom, and lofted cleanly. Brother? Who brother
he goes slower again, on the pads again, Sanga waits this time, gets on a knee and sweeps it to between fine leg and deep backward square, will get two
on the pads, length ball, played into the on side
slower offcutter on ther pads, and helped away towards midwicket
short and angling across, Irfan forces it through the off side
slower offcutter, pitching outside off, and turning towards the stumps, and Sanga turns it around the corner
short, too short for that pace and if the third man is up, Sanga waits, and just guides it over the short thirdman
length ball on the pad, turning away towards off, and turned away towards midwicket
this is theown up, but still a quick offbreak, Sanga looks for the slog-sweep, and misses completely, and the ball misses the off stump by a whisker
short and fast, angling in, 100ks, and a single towards midwicket
same leg-stump line, no room there, and just a single to long-on
thrown up, on the pads, played wristily to long-on
thrown up, on a length, just outside off, played to long-off
flat topspinner on the pads, Sanga looks for the pull, it's too full for the pull, and the pace also beats him
fuller, strighter one, and Irfan gets a single to mid-off
quick, legbreak, cramps Irfan who is looking to push it through the off side
this one is flatter, just outside off, and guided to thirdman
lovely shot, best way to play a spinner, stepped out, got right to the pitch, down on a knee, and lofts it straight down the ground
short of a length, outside off, turning in, cramps Irfan, who manages a single to point
another dot ball, beats Sanga on the sweep, just outside leg, good line of attack, if he can throw in the odd variation
fullish, on the stumps, no room, and defended back to the bowler
thrown up, just outside off, and driven through the covers
full, on the pads, no time for turn, and he turns it around the corner
pitches it just outside leg, on a length, gets it to break onto the pads, and beats Sanga
tossed up, on off stump, IKP is early, and gets in inside-edge onto the pad and gets a quick single
just short of a length, on the leg stump, and helped into the leg side
whoa, Irfan steps down again, connects, and gets a six, it just cleared the deep midwicket
just short of a length, breaks in big, cramps him up
that's SK Warne son, you don't just step down, which Irfan did, Warne saw it, shortened the length, and Irfan's pads save him
a touch shorter, bunted down towards point, and they run through
and beats the outside edge right away, thrown up, outside off, Sanga plays for spin, but it doesn't turn much, loud shout from rawat, but umpire is not impressed
fullish, but on the stumps, and played straight towards long-off, will be just a single
that's a misfield at midwicket by Kamran, this ball was a touch straighter, played towards midwicket where Kamran just dives over it, and costs two runs
bang on target again, same delivery, a touch slower, and defneded off the back foot
on target, is Munaf, length delivery, middle stump, just angling across, and Irfan defends it to mid-off

No. 2 for Munaf, this is pure pressure, just short of a length, Mahela looks to loft over mid-off, the ball stops a touch, and Mahela has to check the shot, but he ends up lobbing it straight to mid-off
short and wide, cut away hard by Mahela, Yusuf runs from thirdman, fumbles, but it doesn't cost them, they were taking two anyway
Mahela looks to paddle, but the length is too short, and just limply scoops it, but it lands safely
same length, just outside off, angling in, and defended into the off side
short and angling across, and Sanga plays it to sweeper-cover
slower ball, just outside off, short of a length, and played down to thirdman
just short of a length, on the off, and Mahela defends with an open face
full, and angling across, and driven through extra
pulls the length back again, it's a touch wide, and Mahela doesn't play at it
a touch fuller, looking to squeeze it through bat-pad gap, Mhela's bat comes down on time and gets him two to wide of mid-on
on the target again, stump to stump, just short of a length, just a single to midwicket
another back-of-a-length delivery, and this time Mahela gets a single to thirdman
just short of a length, outside off, and Mahela lets it go

and Munaf strikes first ball too, what does Warnie tell them, four overs from this end, and three first deliveries have resulted in wickets. this was a superb delivery, length ball, on off, seamed away, and Yuvraj hung his rod, and Rawat caught the edge
tossed up on leg, and Sanga has seen eneough, he slog-sweeps along the ground, and beats the deep backwards sqaure leg
short on leg stump, and played towards midwicket
chips down the track, and chips over the mid-on fielder, only just
attacks leg stump again, and swept straight to short fine
now goes middle stump, full and stright, and defended
gets it all wrong this time, way down leg
gets it right now, pitches fourth stump, moves toward leg, and Yuvraj gets a single to fine leg
another one, and it doesn't turn again
aims for that leg-stump line that so annoyed Gayle, but this pitches outside leg and doesn't spin enough
classical, old school, it's a wide half-volley, Sanga gets down a knee, and caresses it through the gap between mid-off and extra cover
short, on stumps, defended into the leg side, and Sanga sends Yuvraj back, there was no run... no direct-hit, but Yuvraj would have just made it, only just
slower ball again, drifting down leg, and it's too far down leg
short and wide, Sanga looks for the big cut, but the extra bounce beats his bat
almost played on, short, angling in towards off, and Sanga's pads save him from the inside edge
full, on off, driven to the right of  mid-off, good start for Yuvraj, off the middle of the bat
angled down the leg, way down
Kamran comes back again, and he strikes first up, slower ball, a low fulltoss on the leg stump, dipping on Bopara who is way early and lobs it to the left of mid-on, where Munaf takes a diving catch
drives haven't worked for him so far, so Sanga slogs, this time he waited for the ball to come on, at 113ks, cleared his front leg, and picked it from in front of stumps and hit it over midwicket
pitched up, angling across, and Sanga looks to crash it trhough the off side, but this doesn't have enough pace on it
just short of length, on the stumps, drops it with soft hands towards Jadeja at midwicket, and rushes through for one
slower cutter, on the stumps, and defended
scoop, lovely shot, gets down on a knee, across the stumps, gets low enough, and helps it over fine leg
length ball, on the off stump, defended back to the bowler
good line and length, just short of a length, on off stump, bowled from very close to the umpire, so it doesn't angle much, and there is no room for Sanga
shortern, on the stumps, Sanga looks to cut, but is early into the shot, and inside-edges it onto the pitch
now Munaf works some pace, 133ks, fullish, just outside off and straightening, Sanga defends into the off side
wider, fuller, moving away, and Bopara plays it with an open face to thirdman
this is closer to off stump, same length, and Bopara plays it straight to mid-off
loosener, gentle-paced, not much wrong with line and length, just short of a length, just outside off, and Bopara crashes it on the up, through covers
did that stay low a touch? Bopara seemed to bend more than he would, a length ball on middle, and dropped into on side and another quick single taken
just short of a length, angling across, bunted into the off side and they set off for a quick single
finally runs off the bat, off the edge rather, this one seamed away after pitching off, and got the edge, wide of slip
another slower delivery, 107ks, just short of a length, but Sanga steps down to drive, but can't beat mid-off
length delivery, angling across, but slower at 113ks, and defended into the covers. Still waiting for the first runs off the bat
short, angling across, Sanga looks to steer, but can't beat point

just short of a length, on the pads, and played towards short leg. So Kamran has bowled three super overs in a row. One earned Rajasthan a tie against Kolkata, the other was the designated Super Over of the tiebreaker that Rajasthan won, and now he starts off with a one-run over, which includes a run-out
full and stright again, no swing, 137ks, and played into the cover
full, straight, Bopara looks to drive, it goes square, straight to point
this one angles across, starts middle, towards off, played with open face, but there is no single available
in-swinger again, but this starts outside leg and goes further
full, angling across this time, and left alone

wicket first ball, for the second time today after Kallis in the first game. This is a run-out, after Bopara is beaten by an inswinger. Goel wants a quick leg-bye, Bopara sees Jadeja swoop in quickly from square leg and refuses to run. Jadeja throw it to Asnodkar, who backs up from mi-off and finds Goel short

fulltoss, hit into the covers, along the ground, stright to a fielder, and that's what has happened throughout the second half of the innings - they have hit along the ground, and straight to fieldsmen. No sixes in the innings. Punjab get two points, and Rajasthan hit the second-lowest slot of the table
yorker, dug out, towards cover, Warne ambles, is not looking where the ball has gone, the point fielder has a shy and would have caught Warne short had he hit
full, hit straight, to long-off, the story of this innings
slower bouncer, and Rawat - even after adjusting his shot - is too early
Irfan from round the stumps, angles it down, and Warne is hit in the pads
full, around off, Warne steps down and hits it wide of long-off
Warne makes room, heaves the length delivery, towards backward square-leg
slower delivery, on off, Rawat makes room, gets the outside half of the bat and a single
full, and played towards mid-off, it's gone now for Rajasthan
angled across again, and guided towards thirdman
and Rawat misses completely, angled across, and looks to run it to thirdman
timber! Jadeja, desperate Jadeja, steps out, is beaten by a swinging yorker. Stumps are splayed
full again, and Jadeja hits it npowerfully, but straight at the bowler, VRV gets a hand to it, and they take a single off the deflection
fulltoss, Warne makes room, then walks back across, moves too much, and ends up playing it straight down
lucky again, makes room, fullish delivery on the stumps, goes off the slice towards thirdman, but falls short
fuller ball, drivable, Warne makes room, and opens the face towards sweeper-cover
almost a yorker, Jadeja makes room, hits it wide of mid-off, in circle, but can't beat him
length ball, Warne looks to smoke the leather off it, but hits it straight to long-off
fulltoss, and wasted by Warne, hits hard, but straight to Powar at extra cover
that's a perfect fulltoss, wait-band high, can't do much with it, and dabs it down
slower ball, full outside off, only a single this time
round the wicket, low fulltoss, Warne hits towards Powar at long-off, and goes "push, push", Jadeja pushes and beats Powar's direct-hit
premeditated and executed well, he was always going midwicket, got a length delivery on middle stump, clears the front leg, and swings over midwicket
Warme walks across, Irfan looks to go around him, but misses the leg stump by a bit
and starts with a lovely slower delivery, starts around off, cuts away, and beats a defensive prod
angling in, and nudged away towards square leg
another fast and flat delivery, Jadeja opens the face again, but can't beat the short thirdman
big heave here, but this is slower, and gets the inside edge and runs past fine leg
yorker, good bowling, fast and full, and played back to bowler
short again, looks to open his face, but misses
flat and fast, across Jadeja, who opens the face, it runs off the bat, stright to short third man, which is pretty straight
this was a sharp delivery, faster, and full across the batsman, just short of beign a yorker, and Warne can't get bat to it
what placement, what luck, slower ball, Jadeja gives it the full whammy, slices off the face, and falls between keeper, thirdman and point
slower delivery, around the off stump, and Warne dabs it toweards point and rushes through
full, angled across, and Warne looks to lift it over cover, and is beaten
is Warne turning it around? short, on the hips, lifts his front foot, and helps it fine, for four, it's possible still
wide down the leg, got it completely wrong here
length ball, angling across, hit away on the up, but mid-off is in the circle
slowed down, flighted outside off, Warne gets to the pitch of the ball and plays it towards long-off
thrown up, on off, and hit hard, but can't beat Yuvraj
on the atrget, just short of a length, on the off stump, defended
short and angled across, and this time Jadeja manages to hit wide of sweeper-cover, but VRV runs well to prevent a boundary
this one angles into the pads, and an easy single into the leg side
length delivery, on off, strightens a touch, and defended
full and flat, outside off, Warne gets across and plays it towards midwicket, across the line, and gets a single. Ends a superb spell by Chawla, 22 runs and two wickets
length delivery, on the pads, and he takes a single towards midwicket
topspinner, on the off, hurries him, and he can't play a forceful shot
thrown up on leg again, and swept away to fine leg
just short of a length, on the pads, Jadeja looks to dab it into the leg side for a single, but can't beat the close-in fielder
flighted, on the pad, and defended into the leg side
short and wide, and dabbed away square
flighted, outside leg, Jadeja thinks he has not covered the leg stump, so goes to sweep, and gets the bottom part of the bat, fine, very fine, for four
full outside off, isn't thrown up high, Warne drives down the ground and along the ground
this is shorter and flatter and Jadeja pushes it towards sweepeer-cover, that's one fielder he hasn't been able to beat all night
oh ho ho ho, lovely offspin, flight, above eye level,then it dips, around off, and turns sharply, beaten all ends up
Warne looks to walk across, Powar is unfazed, throws it up, outside off, and driven to long-off
pitched up now, Jadeja gets onto front foot too early, and ends up playing around his front pad, and plays straight to midwicket
deft touch here, shortish, just angling across off, Jadeja opens the face at the last moment
short and wide, and Warne cuts it away to sweeper-cover
slog sweep, from outside off, and Warne connects well, and clears midwicker easily
flighted, overpitched, Warne plays it to the left of Chawla, he does well to keep them down to a dot
on the pads, full, and turned away to fine leg
again looks to attack Jadeja with short deliveries from round the stumps, Jadeja runs it down, wide of slip, towards thirdman
length delivery, angling into the pads, Warne takes half a step across, and plays it towards square leg
short and wide, cut hard, but finds out sweeper-cover
short of a length, on the off, and Warne opens the face of the bat to get a single to third man
another short ball, gets high, chest high, Jadeja waits for it, and opens the face down to thirdman
VRV is giving Jadeja some trouble with short-pitched bowling, this time he tucks him up again, and Jadeja can't make enough room to guide it towards thirdman
flighted outside off, and defended off the front foot
onto the pads this time, and helped away to wide of midwicket

this one shows Raut has no clue what Chawla is bowling, steps out, finds himself short of the pitch of the ball, gives it his all, his all takes it up miles into the air, and towards Powar at mid-off, who makes good ground to hold on to this steepler
thrown up, just outside off, Raut looks to run it to leg side from there, and misses completely
angled across Jadeja, who mplays it with soft hands, and takes a quick single
full, into the pads, can't beat midwicket

it had everyone belive there was an edge, fullish delivery outside off, raut looks to run it down - depsite there being a slip - the bat and pad are close together, and it goes off the pad to Sanga. A polite enquiry is all that ensues
wide, on a length, crunchy square-drive, but straight towards sweeper-cover
short outside off, angling in, and Jadeja looks to push it, no footwork again, playing away from body
short, into the hips, tucks him up, and Jadeja plays it down towards square leg, and scmapers and runs two
almost gets en edge, short and wide, Jadeja plays from where he is standing, and is beaten on the cut
from round the wicket, pitches on a length on off, straightens just a touch to make sure there is no attacking shot possible
short, straight delivery, on the pads, and turned away into the leg side
flat, just outside off, and played off the front foot for a single into the covers

the big man sinks, what a huge wicket, Yusuf looks for the trademark sweep, but the ball pitches too close to him, and outside off, it takes the top edge that lobs straight to short fine, and will we have an encore of Rajasthan's 58 all out against Bangalore?
short, pushed through, 85ks, and helped into the on side
googly, edge, and just wide of slip, on the off, Jadeja plays with soft hands, this spins across, and takes the edge, but wide of slip
shortish, on the pads, and an easy single towards midwicket
this is a better short delivery, just outside off, hurries him, and he defends it on his toes to keep it down
nice deflection, this was a boouncer aimed at his ribs from round the stumps, Jadeja went back in his crease, stood tall, and nudged it fine of fine leg
shorter this time, just short of a length, outside off, Yusuf waits on it, and dabs it towards thirdman
yorker this time, just outside off, and played straight into the ground
and again, half-volley just outside off, and hit hard, but straight to Yuvraj at mid-off
gets away with a loosener, gentle pace, on a length, outside off, blasted straight back, but can't beat mid-off
almost another wicket, short and wide, Jadeja lookls to cut, without any footwork, and almost edges it
tries a bouncer, outside off, and Jadeja doesn't want to play at it
length ball, on the off, driven on the up, but can't beat cover

Abdulla strikes again, lovely offcutter, pitches on leg stump, just short of a length, Dimi looks to defend but plays inside the line, the offcut beats the bat, and takes the top of off. Superb show by Punjab's left-arm seamers
and four right away, this one asked to be hit, short and wide, and Dimi slashes it through point, thirdman has no chance

this happens to you only on a very lucky day, this one was angled down leg, slipping away, Quiney looks to flick it for four, but there is a noise as it passes him, and the keeper goes up, and he is given. Lucky wicket, but Rajasthan in deep trouble now
Yusuf is warming up, this pone swung in, almost a yorker on the leg stump, and Yusuf digs it out and manages to flick for four to square leg
this is the away-going delivery, moving away from around off, Yusuf looks to dab, but misses
IKP gives room this time, YKP capitalises, pitched up, wide of off, and Yusuf gets on a knee and lofts it over square field
well done Pathan brothers, Yusuf walks down, flicks it straight, but Irfan dives and keeps it to a dot ball
this is short, there is no time for it to swing, but Yusuf pushes it off the front foot, towards mid-off, and shouts "no" right away
Irfan continues to his brother, length ball, swinging in a bit from middle stump, played towards midwicket
on target now, just short of driving length, starts off stump, straightens a bit, and defended back
slower ball, outside off, and Quiney lets it go
short of a length, angling in, big shout for lwb, but there is an inside edge
that's easy meat, no swing, full and wide, and Quiney carresses it through the off side, with a "thank you" note
shout for lbw, but not convincing, Quiney fell over a bit, but it was angling across
angling into the pads here, and just eased through the leg side
pitched on a length, just outside off, and a forward defensive from Yusuf

what a beauty, perfect delivery for a left-arm swing bowler, just short of a driving length, pitching off, and then moving away, and kissing the bat on the way... perfect, what ba start for Irfan, two wickets in one over following his 39 with the bat
Smith walks across, Irfan gets some swing here, and Smith just defends it into cover, playing from a length, just outside off
Smith walks across, irfan tries it to fire it down leg, and angles it too far across
just short of a length, on the stumps, stays low a bit, and Smith plays it towards mid-on
length ball, angling into his pads, and dropped into the leg side for an easy single
and Irfan's good night continues, short, Asnodkar goes for the pull, but there is some extra bounce that gets his top-edge, straight to Powar at mid-on, it's game on
wide, looking for swing perhaps, but this too far outside off and keeps going further away
another flighted delivery, just outside off, turning in, and Asnodkar turns it around the corner and hares across for a single
flighted on the leg stump, 80ks, turns away, gets the outside half of the bat, but a single ensues
slow but way down leg
flighted, slowed down, 70ks, and just outside off, and Smith lets it go
short and wide, and Powar gets away with, Asnodkar cuts, but this goes straighter and towards cover, just a single
the leg attack, as Yusuf tried, just pitched outside off, spun towards the stumps, and Smith dabs it towards midwicket
and Powars starts with a short, stright delivery, but he has a deep midwicket for cover, so this will just be a single
